# NKG Auto Repair

> NKG Auto Repair is a family-owned auto repair shop at 1400 Carroll Ave, San Francisco, CA 94124, in the Bayview-Hunters Point neighborhood. It has served San Francisco drivers since 2009. Open Monday through Saturday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; closed Sunday. Walk-ins welcome. Phone (415) 239-7450.

## Shop facts

- Name: NKG Auto Repair (listed on Google Maps as "N-K-G Auto Repair")
- Address: 1400 Carroll Ave, San Francisco, CA 94124, USA, in Bayview-Hunters Point
- Nearby: a short drive from Silver Terrace, Visitacion Valley, Portola, Excelsior, and Dogpatch
- Phone: (415) 239-7450
- Email: nkgautorepair@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday through Saturday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Closed Sunday.
- Appointments: not required. Mostly first-come, first-served; appointments are accepted.
- In business since: 2009. Local and family-owned.
- Vehicles serviced: most gas-powered cars, SUVs, small vans, hybrids, and light-duty pickup trucks
- Vehicles not serviced: fully electric vehicles, commercial heavy-duty trucks
- Payment: cash, credit and debit cards, and mobile payments such as Apple Pay and Google Pay
- Estimates: a clear estimate before any work begins. Final cost depends on the vehicle, parts, and labor.
- Relative price tiers: oil changes $; brake repair, engine diagnostics, and AC repair $$; transmission service and suspension and steering $$$
- Same-day work: oil changes, brake pad replacements, battery swaps, and inspections can usually be done the same day
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=3295061106940250335
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61562081127971

For anything not listed here, such as exact prices or warranty terms, call the shop at (415) 239-7450.

## Services

- [Oil changes](https://nkgautorepair.com/services/oil-change/): oil and filter change with the oil type and amount the vehicle calls for; walk-in, usually done the same day
- [Brake repair](https://nkgautorepair.com/services/brake-repair/): inspection of pads, rotors, and brake fluid; pad and rotor replacement; pad replacement usually same day
- [Check engine light and engine diagnostics](https://nkgautorepair.com/services/engine-diagnostics/): computer scan plus testing to confirm the cause before any repair
- [Transmission service](https://nkgautorepair.com/services/transmission-service/): inspection and diagnosis, fluid check and fluid service, leak inspection, and a repair plan with an estimate
- [Suspension and steering](https://nkgautorepair.com/services/suspension-steering/): inspection and repair of shocks, struts, control arms, bushings, and steering components
- [Car AC repair](https://nkgautorepair.com/services/auto-ac-repair/): diagnosis, leak detection, compressor and component repair, and a recharge once the system is sealed
- [All services](https://nkgautorepair.com/services/)

## Lift rental

- [Mechanic lift rental](https://nkgautorepair.com/lift-rental/): a dedicated vehicle lift for independent or mobile mechanics. $150 per day or $2,000 per month. Power, air compressor, and lighting included. Monday through Saturday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Bring your own tools. No commercial lease. Call or text (415) 239-7450 to ask about availability.
